name: Master Poisoner
body:
Prerequisite: Poison Use, Craft (alchemy) 5 ranks.

Benefit: You have mastered little tricks to brewing poisons that better tailor them to your individual style. Whenever you use poison that you created, whether via a weapon, ranger trap, or another distribution method, increase the save DC of that poison by 2. This bonus does not apply if someone else is using the poison, or if you are using poison that you didn’t create.
